messages:
Asha: Quick sync 1: we need a tight spec for enterprise evidence (audit logs + BYOK) to share with sales/legal. Top asks from customers: tenant key handoff, searchable long-term retention, and export SLAs.
Kai: For BYOK onboarding Id propose 3 endpoints: `POST /v1/keystore/handshake`, `POST /v1/keystore/confirm`, and `POST /v1/keystore/rotate`. Handshake must create an escrow token.
Rory: Re-encrypting blobs on rotate is expensive. Can we use envelope keys to avoid mass re-encrypt? tradeoff: more control-plane state vs cheaper rekeying.
Maya: Customers want consistent search semantics. We need a retention->search matrix: hot (90d, instant), warm (1y, indexable with degraded perf), cold (7y, archived; search by export).
Priya (compliance): SOC2 evidence needs immutable append-only audit trail, proof-of-deletion attestations, and region-aware retention policies. Also require legal-hold override that prevents deletion and logs the hold.
Asha: MVP acceptance bullets: 1) BYOK per-tenant binding + escrow proof; 2) Export API (JSONL + WARC) with auth and audit header; 3) Retention tiers: hot=90d, warm=1y, cold=7y (cold archived); 4) Immutable audit trail with immutability flag; 5) Legal-hold flow.
Kai: Retrieval SLAs: Dedicated/Private = 24h for cold, Hosted = best-effort up to 72h. For hot/warm we target export_p99 <= 4h. Need metrics added to Console.
Rory: Ops checklist: monthly canary rotation, automated escrow access test, and a fallback pathway if key transfer fails. I'll sketch failure modes.
Maya: Console UX: onboarding stepper w/ statuses (pending, escrowed, verified). Show estimated retrieval time per retention tier and a single-click export. Also surface compliance docs.
Priya (compliance): Add requirement: retention matrix doc mapping region -> legal-hold semantics -> deletion window. This must be in docs before GA.
Asha: Notes on gating: block GA if legal-hold behavior isn't proven, escrow access test fails, or export_p99 for hot > 4h. Also need runbook for emergency key revocation.
Kai: I'll produce an API contract + example request/response by EOD Friday. Example: `POST /v1/keystore/handshake {"tenant_id":"t-123", "kms_provider":"aws-kms", "key_arn":"arn:..."}` reply includes `escrow_token`.
Rory: I'll write envelope-key design doc and cost delta for rekeying vs envelope approach.
Maya: I'll mock the Console flows and include an acceptance checklist for PM review.
Priya (compliance): I'll draft the compliance checklist and retention matrix with regional notes (US/EU/APAC).
rfc-bot: RFC created: /docs/enterprise-evidence-spec draft-1 assigned to Asha. target_due=2026-04-05.
Asha: Action items recorded: Kai -> API contract, Rory -> envelope-key + failure modes, Maya -> Console mocks + acceptance, Priya -> compliance matrix. I'll assemble a short launch criteria doc and share with Sales/legal. Thanks :thumbsup:
